home.tagline: The right skills. The right price. The right quality.
home.description: Need help? Baltic Bridge connects Nordic buyers with skilled, verified contractors from the Baltics — carpentry, electrical, plumbing, roofing, concrete, welding, steel and more. Transparent information, documented compliance and an easy path to contact.
home.trustLine: Every verified supplier has ops-reviewed documents — F-skatt, A1, insurance and certifications.

home.how2d: Our ops team qualifies your request and invites suitable verified Baltic companies.

sweden.metaTitle: Hire verified Baltic welders & fitters in Sweden | Baltic Bridge
sweden.metaDescription: Baltic subcontracting teams fully verified for work in Sweden: F-skatt, A1, posted-worker notification, ID06, collective-agreement status. Fixed price or hourly — without beställaransvar risk.
sweden.h1: Verified Baltic welding & fitting teams for Swedish projects
sweden.intro: The skills shortage in construction and industry is acute. The Baltics have skilled, certified teams ready to work — and Baltic Bridge makes them easy to hire, with documented compliance.
sweden.costBody: The same certificate requirements (ISO 9606-1, EN 1090) and the same quality bar — at a competitive total cost thanks to a different cost base. With subcontracted work packages you buy a defined scope at a clear price, not staffing. The right skills, the right price, the right quality.
sweden.complianceIntro: As a Swedish buyer you carry the risk if the subcontractor fails compliance. Every verified supplier here has documented and ops-reviewed:
sweden.compliance1: Approved F-skatt with Skatteverket, with approval date
sweden.compliance2: A1 certificate per posted worker (Sodra), with validity dates
sweden.compliance3: Posted-worker notification to Arbetsmiljöverket per assignment
sweden.compliance4: ID06 per worker plus liability insurance with amount and expiry
sweden.compliance5: Collective-agreement status and ISO 9606-1 welder qualifications per worker
sweden.faq1a: Requests and offer comparison are free for the buyer. We charge the supplier a success fee only when a deal closes.
sweden.faq2q: How do I know the verification is real?
sweden.faq2a: Every fact on a supplier profile is reviewed by our ops team against original documents with a full audit trail. The badge switches off automatically the night a critical document lapses.
sweden.faq3a: Subcontracting (entreprenad). You buy a defined work package at fixed or hourly price — the supplier leads its own team.
sweden.faq4q: How fast can a team be on site?
sweden.faq4a: Verified suppliers with A1 and ID06 in place typically mobilize within 2–4 weeks. Capacity listings show each team's earliest start.

norway.metaTitle: Certified Baltic welders for Norwegian projects | Baltic Bridge
norway.metaDescription: Verified Baltic subcontracting teams for Norwegian industry and yards: A1, HSE cards, OAR registration. Documented compliance at significantly lower total cost.
norway.h1: Baltic welding teams for Norwegian industry and shipyards
norway.intro: Norwegian industry and shipyards need certified competence that is hard to find locally. Baltic subcontracting teams with documented compliance are a serious, competitive alternative.
norway.costBody: Internationally certified teams (ISO 9606-1, class approvals) at a competitive total cost with a predictable price per work package. Skills and quality first — the price is the bonus.
norway.complianceIntro: For work in Norway we handle, together with the supplier:
norway.compliance1: A1 certificates per posted worker with validity dates
norway.compliance2: HSE cards for construction and industrial sites
norway.compliance3: Registration in the Assignment and Employment Register (RF-1199/OAR)
norway.compliance4: Generally applied (allmenngjort) wage requirements where applicable — documented
norway.compliance5: ISO 9606-1 welder qualifications and yard certificates per worker
norway.faq1a: The verification engine is fully live for the Sweden corridor. Norway is being prepared — our ops team already brokers Norwegian assignments manually with the same document checks.
norway.faq2a: Several verified suppliers have yard and offshore experience with class approvals. State the requirements in your request and ops will match the right team.
norway.faq3a: Free for the buyer. A success fee is charged to the supplier when the deal closes.
norway.faq4a: Team leads work in English; several teams also have Polish- and Russian-speaking supervisors. State your preferred working language in the request.

denmark.metaTitle: Certified Baltic welders for Danish projects | Baltic Bridge
denmark.metaDescription: Verified Baltic subcontracting teams for Danish industry: A1, RUT registration, arbejdsmiljø requirements. Documented compliance at substantially lower total cost.
denmark.h1: Baltic welding & fitting teams for Danish projects
denmark.intro: Danish industry is searching for certified welders and fitters that are hard to find locally. Baltic teams with proven compliance make projects feasible — with quality intact.
denmark.costBody: The same certificate requirements (ISO 9606-1, hygiene standards for the food industry) at a competitive total cost. Subcontracting with clear responsibility — not a temp agency.
denmark.complianceIntro: For work in Denmark we handle, together with the supplier:
denmark.compliance2: Notification to the RUT register (Registret for Udenlandske Tjenesteydere)
denmark.compliance3: Arbejdsmiljø requirements and site-specific safety inductions
denmark.compliance4: Liability insurance with amount and validity, documented
denmark.compliance5: ISO 9606-1 welder qualifications per worker, incl. hygienic welding for dairy/food
denmark.faq1a: The Sweden corridor is fully live. Denmark is being prepared — the ops team already brokers Danish assignments manually with the same document checks.
denmark.faq2q: Does it work for the food industry?
denmark.faq2a: Yes — several suppliers have hygienic welding competence for dairy and process plants. State the standards in your request.
denmark.faq3a: Free for the buyer. A success fee is charged to the supplier when the deal closes.
denmark.faq4a: With A1 and RUT notification in place: normally 2–4 weeks from accepted offer.
